_comment: Model-profile manifest for OpenCode. The installer reads this file at
install time, picks the profile named by --profile (or defaultProfile),
and renders ~/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc by combining the values
here with config/opencode.template.jsonc.
To add a new profile:
1. Add a new key under 'profiles' with the same shape as 'personal'.
2. Cover every consumer (root, agents, commands) listed in
scripts/validate-config.mjs; the validator will reject profiles
with missing consumers before any installed config is touched.
3. Validate with: node scripts/validate-config.mjs --profile <name>
4. Durable changes go through the OpenSpec workflow at
openspec/changes/<change-name>/. AGENTS.md documents this.
Profile model assignments here MUST resolve against the OpenCode models
catalog (~/.cache/opencode/models.json) when it exists. The validator
checks this; an unresolvable id fails the install with a profile-aware
error message.
'work' is a demonstration profile used by task 2.3 to verify the install
flow can swap model assignments at install time. It is NOT a
recommendation; review and replace with your real work values before
relying on it.
